messages.body: 🚨 INCIDENT DECLARED - Customs message delivery failures reported in xT for IT region. Multiple customers unable to send/receive customs-related documents. Initiating incident response.
@Database Performance Team @Customs Integration Team - Please join incident war room. This is a P1/CR1 incident affecting multiple customers in EMEA.
Investigating... Pulling logs from customs integration service. Initial observation: seeing delayed query responses from the database routine.
Customer feedback: Messages sent hours ago still not delivered. Currently 8-10 customers affected across IT, IE, CH, ES regions.
Joining investigation. Checking database performance metrics - there's a significant queue buildup in the message processing pipeline.
Found it! The database routine 'ProcessCustomsMessages' has query optimizer settings that are only optimal for one of the calling processes. Settings don't match the current workload profile.
Confirming from our end: The routine was originally tuned for the IT integration process, but now we have IE, CH, ES processes also calling it with different query patterns.

Root cause confirmed. The other calling processes (IE, CH, ES) are experiencing performance degradation because their queries don't benefit from the IT-specific optimization. This is creating a backlog.
What's the immediate mitigation? Can we restart with default configuration to unblock customers?
Yes - restarting the routine with default configuration should immediately restore performance for all processes. It won't be optimal for any of them, but all will perform similarly.
Mitigation in progress - stopping the routine now...
✓ Routine restarted with default configuration. Restarting dependent integration processes now.
✓ All integration processes (IT, IE, CH, ES) restarted successfully. Monitoring message queue now.
Queue is starting to clear! Seeing normal query response times now. Backlog processing rate improving.
Receiving reports from customers - messages are now flowing through. Response times back to normal.
All 50K+ messages in backlog have been processed. Query queue is empty. Performance is stable and normal.
✓ INCIDENT RESOLVED - Service fully restored. All affected customers' messages have been processed. Teams can stand down. Database Performance team will work on permanent fix.
Preparing customer communication - will send within 30 minutes with incident summary and resolution details.
✓ Customer communication sent to all 10 affected customers in IT, IE, CH, ES regions. Included incident description, timeline, and resolution confirmation.

Starting detailed analysis of permanent fix. Proposal: Implement process-specific configuration profiles with validation rules. This will allow optimal tuning for each calling process without manual configuration.
Good catch on the root cause. This highlights a gap in our configuration management. We also need automated monitoring to detect similar performance degradation earlier.

Scheduling retrospective for 23 November. Permanent fix target: 30 November. Automated monitoring: 25 November. Configuration documentation: 23 November. Will be documenting prevention measures in internal PIR.
